history.summary: IDENTITY CONFIRMED: Noida Kalibari at E-5C, Kali Bari Road, Block E, Sector 26. A Bengali-community Hindu temple run as a cultural organization promoting Bengali heritage. Durga Puja and Kali Puja have been organized here every year since the 1980s (per Daily Jagran). The complex includes the main Kali shrine plus Radha-Krishna, Shiv ling and Ram Krishna Paramhansa-Maa Sarada idols, a large garden, a dharamshala with reasonably priced AC and non-AC guest rooms, a small canteen, and a free dispensary; the adjacent club is let out for weddings. The building's construction date is undocumented - flag for verification.

town_description: Noida (New Okhla Industrial Development Authority) is a planned industrial city in Gautam Buddha Nagar district, Uttar Pradesh, part of the Delhi NCR. Known for its wide roads, corporate offices and film city, it has a large resident migrant population including Odia, Bengali and Keralite communities, each with its own community temples.
